title: The Migration in April and May
excerpt: April and May are the long rains. The herds move through central Serengeti, the landscape is green and there are very few visitors.
body:
In April and May the long rains fall in Tanzania. Many travellers avoid this period, but there are advantages.

## Where the herds are

After the calving season, the herds start moving north and west through central Serengeti. Large columns of wildebeest can be seen moving across the plains.

## Rain

Rain can be heavy, especially in April. Roads can be muddy, and some camps close.

## Advantages

- Very few vehicles.
- Green landscapes and dramatic skies.
- Lower prices at some lodges.

## Who it suits

Flexible travellers, photographers and repeat visitors.

## Combine with the coast

Zanzibar also has its rainy season in April and May. See [Zanzibar in the rainy season](/blog/zanzibar-rainy-season/).

Read [the green season benefits](/blog/tanzania-green-season-benefits/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
